source: Add a list when a recipe or exercise has many terms. Blank lines are skipped. Each line is added in order, and the working keeps every intermediate sum. This mode adds values; it does not parse a general expression with operator precedence.
translation: > Magdagdag ng isang listahan kapag ang isang recipe o ehersisyo ay may maraming mga tuntunin. Walang laman na linya ay skipped.
